label: Wholly good: outcome minimizer, constraint-respecting rescuer, ontological goodness
resolution: Rowe's WhollyGood field is opaque. WHOLLY_GOOD_1 and WHOLLY_GOOD_2 constrain it by a standard for permitting preventable events; WHOLLY_GOOD_3 reads it as the case's ontological goodness plus good-willing, which says nothing about permitting. outcomeSenseYieldsPermissionConstraint uses WHOLLY_GOOD_1, constraintSenseYieldsQualifiedConstraint uses WHOLLY_GOOD_2, and the goodness-sense controls compare all three without passing from one to another.
